title: Code 4
learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: know the foundations of multiplayer development, networks & protocols, webservers & databases
choose the right solution path for a specific application scenario.
apply basic concepts of web services and multiplayer networking.
analyze network communication of multiuser applications.
combine clients, servers, databases and external services into working networked applications and multiplayer games.
evaluate multiuser applications in terms of performance and robustness.
